events.title: Alphabet stock holds strong as Q2 cloud growth and AI demand reshape the outlook
events.summary: Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) reported a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat, with revenue up 24.2% year-over-year and Google Cloud revenue soaring by 82%. The company's significant investment in AI infrastructure, including its Gemini platform, has led to increased operating income but also resulted in negative free cash flow due to substantial capital expenditures. Institutional investors like Berkshire Hathaway have shown confidence in Alphabet, even as the stock trades below its May 2026 high, indicating a balance between growth potential and investment costs.

articles.headline: Alphabet stock holds strong as Q2 cloud growth and AI demand reshape the outlook

events.title: Here's Why Investors Should Add J.B. Hunt Stock to Their Portfolio
events.summary: J.B. Hunt Transportation (JBHT) is presented as an attractive investment due to its strong performance, outperforming the transportation-truck industry with an 80% surge in shares over the past year. The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), has seen northward estimate revisions for its earnings, and boasts a positive earnings surprise history. Additionally, its efforts toward efficient transportation solutions, disciplined capital allocation, and shareholder-friendly initiatives are highlighted as growth factors.

articles.headline: Here's Why Investors Should Add J.B. Hunt Stock to Their Portfolio

events.title: IDEX stock holds firm after July 29 earnings beat
events.summary: IDEX Corporation's stock remained firm after reporting a Q2 earnings beat on July 29, with quarterly EPS of $2.32 surpassing estimates and revenue reaching $920.60 million. The company's full-year 2026 EPS guidance of $8.70 to $8.85 is slightly below the analyst consensus of $8.82. Despite this, its valuation at 33.60 times earnings is supported by strong sales growth and a significant EPS beat.

articles.headline: IDEX stock holds firm after July 29 earnings beat

events.title: Caterpillar vs. Deere: Which Heavy Equipment Stock Should You Bet On?
events.summary: This article compares two leading heavy equipment stocks, Caterpillar (CAT) and Deere & Company (DE), highlighting their recent financial performance, growth drivers, and market outlooks. Caterpillar shows stronger growth, an upgraded outlook, and a higher Zacks Rank due to its diverse market exposure and robust backlog. While Deere has long-term potential in precision agriculture, near-term challenges in farm economics may limit its upside.

articles.headline: Caterpillar vs. Deere: Which Heavy Equipment Stock Should You Bet On?

events.title: Report: PepsiCo's Network Supported 440,400 Jobs Nationwide and Contributed Nearly $65 Billion to U.S. GDP
events.summary: A new analysis by Oxford Economics reveals that PepsiCo's operations significantly impact the U.S. economy, supporting nearly 440,400 jobs nationwide and contributing approximately $64.88 billion to the U.S. GDP in 2024. The report highlights PepsiCo's reach across various sectors including manufacturing, agriculture, and transportation, and its commitment to sustainability and community initiatives through its pep+ strategy and the PepsiCo Foundation. This extensive footprint underscores the company's deep integration into the American economy and daily life.

articles.headline: Report: PepsiCo's Network Supported 440,400 Jobs Nationwide and Contributed Nearly $65 Billion to U.S. GDP

events.title: Interpublic Group stock enters new phase after Omnicom acquisition integration
events.summary: Interpublic Group stock is now fully integrated into Omnicom following its November 2025 acquisition, making the combined entity the world's largest marketing services firm. Omnicom's fourth-quarter 2025 results are the first to fully incorporate Interpublic Group's financials, allowing investors to assess the combined company's performance and scale. This integration means Interpublic Group's value is now reflected through Omnicom's consolidated metrics, with a focus on their combined revenue growth, margin trends, and cash generation.

articles.headline: Interpublic Group stock enters new phase after Omnicom acquisition integration

events.title: Top 3 Energy Stocks That May Keep You Up At Night In Q3
events.summary: This article identifies three energy stocks—Teekay Corp Ltd (TK), Phillips 66 (PSX), and Peabody Energy Corp (BTU)—that are currently considered overbought based on their Relative Strength Index (RSI) values above 70. Despite recent positive earnings or stock gains, these high RSI figures suggest that momentum-driven investors should exercise caution. The article provides recent performance details and quotes from company executives for each stock.

articles.headline: Top 3 Energy Stocks That May Keep You Up At Night In Q3

events.title: American Airlines stock steadies after guidance cut as investors weigh Q2 2026 rebound
events.summary: American Airlines (AAL) stock is stabilizing in late August 2026 after investors digested its Q2 2026 return to profit and revised full-year guidance, which now includes the possibility of a quarterly loss. Despite thin margins and negative free cash flow, the company showed double-digit revenue growth in Q2, and institutional investors are reportedly buying shares, signaling confidence in its long-term recovery potential. The stock is trading in the lower half of its 52-week range, with analysts assigning a "hold" rating and a consensus price target suggesting potential upside.

articles.headline: American Airlines stock steadies after guidance cut as investors weigh Q2 2026 rebound

events.title: ZenaTech Completes Acquisition of ESM Software, Adding Strategy Execution and Compliance Software to its Enterprise SaaS Division, with Revenue from Government, Healthcare and Financial Services Customers
events.summary: ZenaTech, Inc. has announced the acquisition of ESM Software, a Boston-based company specializing in strategy execution and performance management software. This acquisition expands ZenaTech's enterprise SaaS portfolio, adding crucial capabilities in strategy execution, performance management, and cybersecurity compliance, particularly for government and regulated customers. ESM Software's solutions are expected to be integrated into ZenaTech’s AI-powered enterprise productivity platform, Zoo Office, enhancing its compliance and strategic governance offerings.

articles.headline: ZenaTech Completes Acquisition of ESM Software, Adding Strategy Execution and Compliance Software to its Enterprise SaaS Division, with Revenue from Government, Healthcare and Financial Services Customers

events.title: Home Depot still faces frozen housing market
events.summary: Home Depot's recent profits were boosted by significant tariff refunds, masking a potential decline if these were excluded. The company is facing challenges due to high mortgage rates in the US, which are deterring Americans from moving homes and consequently reducing visits to their stores. This suggests a frozen housing market is negatively impacting their core business.

articles.headline: Home Depot still faces frozen housing market

events.title: Resilient Expeditors stock trades near 52-week high as Q2 2026 earnings beat expectations
events.summary: Expeditors International (EXPD) stock is trading near its 52-week high at $187.81 after reporting better-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings of $2.03 per share, driven by strong airfreight and customs brokerage operations. Despite a consensus analyst "Hold" rating and an average price target of $168.78 suggesting limited upside, the company's strong profitability, efficient use of capital, and recent institutional interest support its current valuation. The contrast between the market price and analyst targets highlights investor confidence in Expeditors' ability to maintain strong margins and returns on equity.

articles.headline: Resilient Expeditors stock trades near 52-week high as Q2 2026 earnings beat expectations

events.title: Occidental Petroleum stock holds a strong 2026 gain as analysts stay cautious
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum (OXY) stock has seen a strong 46% year-to-date gain in 2026, trading in the low-$60s range, partially fueled by a significant Q2 2026 earnings beat. Despite this robust performance, analyst sentiment remains cautious, with a consensus Hold rating and price targets clustered in the mid-$60s, suggesting limited upside without new catalysts. The company's performance has outpaced some peers, reflecting strong operational execution and leverage to commodity prices, but much of this is already factored into the current valuation.

articles.headline: Occidental Petroleum stock holds a strong 2026 gain as analysts stay cautious

events.title: Dollar General stock edges higher as earnings beat odds become focus
events.summary: Dollar General (DG) stock is trading in the mid-$120s as investors await its upcoming quarterly earnings report. Analysts expect a 7.5% year-over-year increase in earnings to $2.00 per share, with a consensus "hold" rating and a one-year price target of $130.42. The company's focus on consumables and its defensive retail model are key factors in its anticipated steady performance amidst macroeconomic uncertainties.

articles.headline: Dollar General stock edges higher as earnings beat odds become focus

events.title: Which Aerospace and Defense Stock Has Dominated in 2026: GE Aerospace, Boeing, or RTX?
events.summary: In 2026, RTX has emerged as the top performer among major aerospace and defense stocks, with a 14% year-to-date gain, followed by GE Aerospace at 11%. Boeing, however, has lagged significantly with a 3% decline. The article highlights that these companies, despite being in the same sector, have fundamentally different business models—GE Aerospace focuses on recurring engine servicing, RTX on a diversified portfolio, and Boeing on airframe manufacturing, explaining their varied performances.

articles.headline: Which Aerospace and Defense Stock Has Dominated in 2026: GE Aerospace, Boeing, or RTX?
